x-m-el-cul-01.title: Credit card ichaizvo "golden ratio" here?
x-m-el-cul-01.topic: Reshiyo, symmetry, nemapateni muunyanzvi nehupenyu hwezuva nezuva
x-m-el-cul-01.goal: Verenga mareshiyo uye uafananidze nechirevo, uye uise muyero wako wekuti musiyano wakakura sei wekubvuma usati washandisa mashoko ekuti "igolden ratio."
x-m-el-cul-01.material: Blog post ine mutsara uyu: 'Credit card irectangle ye85.6mm ne53.98mm, ine reshiyo yedivi refu kudivi pfupi iri golden ratio.' Golden ratio i(1 pamwe nesquare root ye5) yakapatsanurwa ne2, ndiko kuti, inenge 1.618. Hukuru (divi refu : divi pfupi) hwenyaya dzekufananidza ndihwo hunotevera. Pepa reA4 297mm : 210mm, postcard 148mm : 100mm, uye monitor screen ine reshiyo ye16 ku10, 16 : 10.
x-m-el-cul-01.prereq.0: Kuwana reshiyo yekureba kuviri nekupatsanura (chiyero chechikoro chepakati)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuongorora mutsara weblog 'Credit card irectangle yegolden ratio.' Patsanura divi refu nedivi pfupi uye usarudze kuongorora kwakanakisa.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.0: Patsanura divi refu nedivi pfupi uye uise kukosha uku padivi pe1.618.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funga zvakasiyana kana makoshero maviri "akaenzana" uye "akasiyana zvakadii."
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.a: Quotient 1.586 inoitwa 1.6 kana yakadzikwa, saka unogona kutaura kuti chaizvo igolden ratio
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.a: Uri kushandisa kukosha kwakadzikwa kuti kuite sekwakafanana sehumbowo hwe "akaenzana." Tarisa kuti mhedziso inochinja zvichienderana nemadhijiti mangani aunodzika kwaari.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.b: 1.586 ne1.618 dzakasiyana, saka credit card haina chekuita negolden ratio zvachose
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.b: Uri kuigovanisa kuita "akaenzana / zvachose kwete" chete. Hauna kufunga kuti musiyano wakakura sei.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.c: Reshiyo inenge 1.586, iyo yakasiyana ne1.618, saka 'padhuze' ishoko rakarurama
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakafananidza kukosha kwakaverengwa nekukosha kuri muchirevo, uye wakasiyanisa 'akaenzana' ne 'padhuze'.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.d: Reshiyo yakayerwa mu mm inochinja kana yashandurwa kuita cm, saka makoshero haagoni kufananidzwa
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.d: Unofunga kuti reshiyo inochinja kana chikamu chachinja. Tarisa kuti chii chinoitika kureshiyo yekureba kuviri kwakayerwa muchikamu chimwe chete kana chikamu chashandurwa.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.explain: 85.6÷53.98 inenge 1.586, iyo inosiyana negolden ratio 1.618 ne2% inenge. Munyaya yakadai, "padhuze negolden ratio" ishoko rakatendeseka, pane "golden ratio chaizvo."
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.prompt: Wakagadza muyero: 'Kana divi refu ÷ divi pfupi ichisiyana ne1.618 mukati me3%, iri padhuze negolden ratio.' Sarudza nyaya dzose dzinogona kudaidzwa kuti dziri padhuze. (3% ye1.618 inenge 0.049.)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.0: Shandura reshiyo yenyaya imwe neimwe kuita decimal.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bvisa 0.049 kubva ku1.618 uye uwedzere 0.049 ku1.618 kuti uwane interval inobvumirwa iwe pachako, wobva watarisa kana reshiyo imwe neimwe ichiwira mukati mayo.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.a: Tarisa zvakare kuti wakaverenga sei musiyano panhanho yekuwana reshiyo nekuifananidza nemuyero. Verenga kana musiyano pakati pekukosha uku ne1.618 uri mukati merange inobvumirwa.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.b: Wakawana reshiyo uye wakafananidza musiyano ne1.618 nerange inobvumirwa.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.c: Tarisa kana wakaverenga iwe pachako kana musiyano wereshiyo yepostcard ne1.618 uri mukati merange inobvumirwa. Kunzwa kwekuti dzakafanana nemaziso kwakasiyana nekufananidza nemuyero.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.d: Wakashandura 16÷10 kuita decimal uye wakaifananidza nemuyero.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.explain: Credit card chete, 1.586 (musiyano unenge 2.0%), nemonitor, 1.6 (inenge 1.1%), dziri mukati me3%. A4 inenge 1.414 (inenge 12.6%) uye postcard i1.48 (inenge 8.5%), dziri kunze kwerange.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.prompt: Muyero wekubvuma (pano 3%) imuyero wandakagadza. Nyora mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti nei unofanira kugadza muyero usati wataura kuti "igolden ratio," uye kuti chii chekungwarira pakugadza muyero.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mumutsara mumwe kuti nei kutonga kunoitwa pasina muyero kuri dambudziko.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti chii chinoitika kuA4 nepostcard kana ukagadza muyero mukuru zvikuru (semuenzaniso, 20%).
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakapa sechikonzero kuti "kukosha kwakafanana chaizvo" kunenge kusingambovapo muchokwadi here?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora kuti chii chinoitika kana muyero wakakura kana mudiki zvakanyanya here?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura kuti credit card nepostcard zvinopatsanuka sei pasi pemuyero wako here?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.0: Makoshero akayerwa anogara aine kukanganisa uye maruler haana kururama, saka makoshero akaenzana chaizvo anenge asingambovapo. Saka unofanira kutanga wagadza muyero wekubvuma seye1% kana 3%, uye utaure kuti iri padhuze kana iri mukati meiyoyo. Kana ukagadza muyero mukuru zvikuru, rectangle chero ipi inenge ichiva golden ratio.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.1: Rectangle ye1.618 chaizvo inenge isingambovapo muchokwadi, saka unofanira kugadza range seyemukati me5%. Asi kana ukaita range 10%, postcard (musiyano unenge 8.5%) inosanganisirwawo uye muyero unova wakarerukira zvakanyanya.

x-m-el-cul-02.topic: Reshiyo, symmetry, nemapateni muunyanzvi nehupenyu hwezuva nezuva
x-m-el-cul-02.title: Kutsvaga mutsara wakaipa mutebhura yesymmetry
x-m-el-cul-02.goal: Tsvaga uye ugadzirise kukanganisa muchigadziriso chinowedzera huwandu hwemitsetse yesymmetry, uye usarudze iwe pachako kuti zvimiro zvipi zvine mitsetse 2 yesymmetry chaizvo.
x-m-el-cul-02.material: Symmetry inowanzoshandiswa mumapateni echinyakare nekugadzira kwezvivakwa. Mudzidzi akagadzira tebhura inofupisa symmetry yezvimiro. Chimiro chine line symmetry chine mutsetse wesymmetry, mutsetse waunoyambukirana nawo zvakakwana kana ukapeta, uye chimiro chine point symmetry chimiro chinoyambukirana nechekutanga kana chikatendeudzwa hafu yekutenderera (180°) kutenderera poinzi. Imwe yemitsara mutebhura ine kukanganisa.
x-m-el-cul-02.thinking.0: Tsvaga kuti kukanganisa muchigadziriso kuri kupi
x-m-el-cul-02.thinking.1: Gadzirisa kukanganisa uye utsanangure kuti ungaongorora sei
x-m-el-cul-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva line-symmetric figures (dzinoyambukirana kana dzapetwa nemutsetse) ne point-symmetric figures (dzinoyambukirana kana dzatendeudzwa 180° kutenderera poinzi)
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mutebhura une zvirimo zvakaipa.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira kupeta chimiro chemutsara wega wega nepepa uye uverenge mitsetse yacho yesymmetry imwe nenguva.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.hint.1: Usapomera mutsara mumwe chete nokuti une mitsetse yakawanda yesymmetry; tarisa mutsara wega wega kana chimiro chichiyambukirana zvechokwadi kana chapetwa.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.0: Equilateral triangle: ine mitsetse 3 yesymmetry uye haisi point-symmetric figure.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.1: Square: ine mitsetse 4 yesymmetry uye ipoint-symmetric figure.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.2: Rectangle (isiri square): mitsetse 2 yenzira yekureba neyeupamhi nemadiagonals maviri, 4 muhuwandu, mitsetse yesymmetry, uye ipoint-symmetric figure.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.3: Parallelogram (isiri rectangle kana rhombus): haina mitsetse yesymmetry, uye ipoint-symmetric figure.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.4: Regular pentagon: ine mitsetse 5 yesymmetry uye haisi point-symmetric figure.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 wakaipa. Kana ukapeta rectangle isiri square nemudiagonal, divi refu rinoenda pamusoro pedivi pfupi uye mavertices haayambukirani. Ine mitsetse 2 yesymmetry chete, kupeta nepakati nenzira yekureba neyeupamhi. Chikamu chinoti ipoint-symmetric chakarurama.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa zvinotaurwa nemutsara 3, uye unyore kuti ungaongorora sei kuti diagonal haisi mutsetse wesymmetry muchimiro ichocho.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti divi refu nedivi pfupi zvinoenda kupi kana ukapeta pepa rerectangular nemudiagonal.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti nhamba yakagadziriswa i2 uye kuti mitsetse inoenda nzira ipi here?
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura, uchishandisa kureba kwemativi kana mavertices, kuti nei kupeta nemudiagonal kusingayambukirani here?
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakasiyanisa izvi nekuti nei madiagonals esquare ari mitsetse yesymmetry here?
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.model.0: Rectangle ine mitsetse 2 yesymmetry. Kana ukaipeta nemudiagonal, divi refu rinorara padivi pfupi, saka mavertices haayambukirani.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.model.1: Pane mitsetse miviri yesymmetry chete, kupeta nepakati nenzira yekureba neyeupamhi. Kana ukapeta nemudiagonal, triangle imwe haiiti pamusoro peimwe. Nokuti kureba kwemativi kwakasiyana.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza zvimiro zvose zviri pazasi zvine mitsetse 2 yesymmetry chaizvo.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dhirowa mitsetse yose iyo chimiro chimwe nechimwe chinoyambukirana nayo kana chapetwa.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.hint.1: Fananidza kuti mitsetse yesymmetry inopfuura kupi murectangle nerhombus.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.r.a: Iyi mhedzisiro yekuverenga mitsetse yesymmetry nekupeta.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.r.b: Peta zvakare kuverenga kuti chimiro ichi chine mitsetse yesymmetry mingani. Funga nemutsetse unopfuura paapex angle chete.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.r.c: Unogona kunge wakavhiringidza chivakwa chekuva point-symmetric nechivakwa chekuva line-symmetric. Tarisa zvakasiyana nekupeta kana chichiyambukirana.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.r.d: Ichi chimiro chine madiagonals maviri ari mitsetse yesymmetry. Ndiyo mhedzisiro yekuverenga uchisiyanisa point symmetry ne line symmetry.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.explain: Rectangle ine 2, munzira yekureba neyeupamhi, uye rhombus ine 2, madiagonals ayo maviri. Isosceles triangle ine 1 uye parallelogram ine 0.

x-m-el-cul-03.material: Pamutsara wemablock 100 epamutsetse, mablock matsvuku nemablock eblue anoiswa nenzira. Pateni inotora 'mablock matsvuku r anotevedzerwa ne (p−r) mablock eblue' seboka rimwe uye inodzokorora boka iri. Mamiriro ndiwo anotevera. (1) p inhamba yechisikwa kubva ku2 kusvika ku50, uye r inhamba yechisikwa kubva ku1 kusvika pazasi pe p. (2) Boka rekupedzisira harina kucheka, uye mablock 100 anopera zvakakwana. (3) Pane mablock matsvuku 40 chaizvo (40% yehuwandu hwose).

x-m-el-cul-03.s.s1.because.model.0: Mabhuroku matsvuku ndi 40% yechose, kureva 2/5, saka mabhuroku matsvuku anofanira kuva 2/5 muboka rimwe zvakare. Kuti r ive nhamba yechisikigo, p inofanira kuva kamu re 5.

x-m-el-cul-09.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti eighth notes dzingani dzinofanira kuuya pamwe chete kuti dzive nhamba yakazara yema beats here?

x-m-el-cul-09.s.s1.because.model.1: Eighth note imwe i beat 0.5, saka nehuwandu hweodd, huwandu hwe beats une .5 yakasara uye haugone kuita ma beats 4. Saka huwandu i even.
x-m-el-cul-09.s.s1.because.model.2: Eighth notes mbiri pamwe chete dzinoita beat rimwe, saka kana kune huwandu hweodd dzadzo, hafu yebeat inosara uye haugone kuzadza ma beats 4, nhamba yakazara yema beats.

x-m-el-cul-04.title: Basa rekuhwirudzira rakaderedza marara here?
x-m-el-cul-04.goal: Kutonga chirevo chechikonzero kubva padata rokuti 'marara akadzika mushure mebasa rekuhwirudzira,' rongera kuti ndeupi ruzivo runodikanwa, uye unyore zvakananga kuti mhedziso inoshanduka sei zvichienderana nemhedzisiro.
x-m-el-cul-04.material: Hofisi yedunhu yakaita basa rekuhwirudzira rekudzokorora muna 2024. Maererano nedata rehofisi yedunhu, avhareji yemwedzi yemarara emhuri yakaenda kubva ku 1,200 matani muna 2023, gore risati rabasa rekuhwirudzira, kusvika ku 1,080 matani muna 2025, kuderera kwe 10% (10% ye 1,200 ndi 120). Webhusaiti yehofisi yedunhu inoti, 'Basa rekuhwirudzira rekudzokorora rakaderedza marara ne 10%.'
x-m-el-cul-04.thinking.0: Tonga hukama pakati pechirevo neruzivo runodikanwa
x-m-el-cul-04.prereq.1: Kuverenga shanduko nenguva kubva pagirafu kana tafura
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.prompt: Kuongorora chirevo chokuti 'basa rekuhwirudzira ndicho chikonzero,' ndeupi ruzivo pakati pezvinotevera runodikanwa? Sarudza zvese zvinodikanwa.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kunyange 'kuderera kwe 10%' kuri chokwadi, kuti chikonzero ibasa rekuhwirudzira kunofanira kutariswa zvakasiyana. Nyora zvikonzero kunze kwebasa rekuhwirudzira zvingaita kuti kuderera kuitike.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tonga kana sarudzo imwe neimwe ichibatsira kubvisa chikonzero chimwe kunze kwebasa rekuhwirudzira.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.o.a: Huwandu hwevagari vakapinda mupetition yebasa rekuhwirudzira
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.r.a: Huwandu hwevakapinda hungakuudza kuti basa rakashanda sei. Asi hahugoni kuparadzanisa kana chikonzero chekuderera chaiva basa rekuhwirudzira kana chimwe chikonzero.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.o.b: Mafambiro emarara emakore akati wandei pamberi pebasa rekuhwirudzira
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.r.b: Iyi ndiyo pfungwa yekutarisa kana kuyerera kwakanga kwatotanga kuderera zvisinei nebasa rekuhwirudzira.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.o.c: Mwedzi une marara akawanda zvakanyanya muna 2025
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.r.c: Kukosha kukuru kwemwedzi mumwe hakushandiswi zvakananga kutonga kana kuderera kwe 10% kuri nekuda kwebasa rekuhwirudzira.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.o.d: Shanduko munguva imwe chete mudunhu rakafanana risina kuita basa rekuhwirudzira
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.r.d: Iyi ndiyo pfungwa yekutarisa nekuenzanisa kana paiva nechimwe chinhu kunze kwebasa rekuhwirudzira.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.o.e: Shanduko yehuwandu hwevanhu kana hwemhuri mudunhu munguva imwe chete
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.r.e: Iyi ndiyo pfungwa yekutarisa kana huwandu hwose huchiderera nokuti huwandu hwevanhu hwakashanduka.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.explain: Kuti utaure chikonzero, unoda (1) mafambiro asati abasa rekuhwirudzira, (2) boka rekuenzanisa risina kuita basa rekuhwirudzira, uye (3) shanduko dzekumashure sehuwandu hwevanhu. Huwandu hwevakasaina petition nemwedzi une kukosha kukuru hazvishandiswi zvakananga kuparadzanisa chikonzero chekuderera kwe 10%.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s1.acc.0: Mafambiro nedunhu rekuenzanisa ndiwo ruzivo rwakakosha. Kutarisawo shanduko yehuwandu hwevanhu kunoita kuti zvive zvechokwadi zvakanyanya.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza chimwe cheruzivo rwunodikanwa, uye unyore kuti mhedzisiro ipi yaro ichava humbowo hwedivi rokuti 'basa rekuhwirudzira rakaita mhedzisiro' uye mhedzisiro ipi ichava humbowo hwedivi rokuti 'zvakaoma kutaura kuti paiva nemhedzisiro.'
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s2.hint.0: Funga zvakasiyana kana ruzivo rwawasarudza ruri 'rukuru' uye kana ruri 'rudiki.'
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s2.hint.1: Tonga munyaya imwe neimwe kana tsananguro yokuti 'nekuda kwebasa rekuhwirudzira' ichidenha.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here mhedzisiro dzese mbiri dzakapesana dzeruzivo rwawasarudza?
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here 'saka ndinotonga izvi' kumhedzisiro yega yega?
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Zviri pachena here kuti wakasarudza ipi, boka rekuenzanisa kana chinhu chekumashure?
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s2.model.0: Kana tikatarisa shanduko mudunhu rekuenzanisa munguva imwe chete: kana dunhu rekuenzanisa rakaramba rakangofanana uye dunhu redu chete rakadzika 10%, iro ihumbowo hwemhedzisiro yebasa, uye kana dunhu rekuenzanisa rakadzikawo anenge 10%, zvakaoma kutaura kuti zvakange zviri nekuda kwebasa rekuhwirudzira.
x-m-el-cul-04.s.s2.model.1: Kana tikatarisa mafambiro emakore akati wandei pamberi pebasa rekuhwirudzira: kana aiva akatsiga uye akadzika mushure mebasa rekuhwirudzira chete, tinogona kutaura kuti paiva nemhedzisiro, uye kana yakatova mafambiro ekudzika 10% gore rega rega, zvakaoma kutaura kuti ndiyo mhedzisiro yebasa rekuhwirudzira.

x-m-el-cul-05.title: Nyaya yemusha une "avhareji ye 400만 원"
x-m-el-cul-05.goal: Shandura kutonga kwako pese painoratidzwa data nedanho, uye utaure zvausingagoni kuziva kubva paavhareji oga.
x-m-el-cul-05.material: Chiziviso chemusha chinoti, 'Avhareji yemari yemwedzi yemhuri dzemusha wedu 10 ndi 400만 원.' Unoda kutonga musha mushure mekuverenga chiziviso ichi.
x-m-el-cul-05.thinking.0: Shandura kutonga kwako kuti kuwirirane neruzivo rutsva
x-m-el-cul-05.thinking.2: Nyora patsva kuva mutsara usingakonzeri kunzwisisa kwakaipa
x-m-el-cul-05.prereq.0: Zvinoreva avhareji nemedian (kukosha kwepakati kana kwarongwa nesaizi)
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chimwe pachimwe. Padanho rega rega, sarudza kutonga kwakanakisa wobva waishandura.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.hint.0: Pese painowedzera ruzivo rwakaratidzwa, paradzanisa 'zvaunogona kutaura zvechokwadi neruzivo urwu' ne 'zvausingagoni kutaura zvino.'
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.hint.1: Funga nezvimwe kuparadzirwa kwemari kunopa avhareji ye 400.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Ruzivo rwega rwakaratidzwa ndirwo rokuti 'avhareji yemari yemwedzi yemhuri 10 ndi 400만 원.'
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kubva paruzivo urwu oga, unogona kutaura kuti mhuri dzinenge dzingani dzine mari yemwedzi ye 400만 원 kana kupfuura?
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Avhareji ndiyo huwandu hwekukosha kwese hwakakamurwa nehuwandu hwemhuri, saka neavhareji imwe chete, musha unoparadzirwa mari zvakaenzana nemusha une mhuri imwe yakakwira zvikuru zvose zvinogoneka.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Vazhinji (mhuri 8 kana kupfuura) vachava pa 400만 원 kana kupfuura
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Unofunga kuti kana avhareji ari 400, vazhinji vari padyo ne 400. Gadzira seti imwe yedata yakasiyana ine avhareji ye 400.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Mhuri 5 chaizvo dzichava pa 400만 원 kana kupfuura
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uri kuvhiringidza avhareji ne 'pakati.' Avhareji nekukosha kwepakati zvinogara zvakafanana here?
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Haugoni kuziva kuti mhuri dzingani kubva paavhareji oga
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakanongedza kuti avhareji haitiudzi kuparadzirwa kwekukosha.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Zvino, median inoratidzwa. Median ndiko kukosha kwepakati kana mari yarongwa kubva padiki, uye kune mhuri 10 ndiyo avhareji yemari yechishanu neyechitanhatu (5 ne 6). Median yemusha uyu ndi 250만 원.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kana ukatarisa avhareji ye 400만 원 nemedian ye 250만 원 pamwe chete, ndiyo huwandu hukuru zvakanyanya hwemhuri dzine mari yemwedzi ye 400만 원 kana kupfuura?
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana median iri 250, mari yemhuri 5 dziri kurutivi rwakadzika dzese ndi 250 kana pasi, saka kusvika mhuri 5 ndidzo dzine 400만 원 kana kupfuura. Kana avhareji yakakura zvikuru kupfuura median, zvingatoitika kuti kukosha kushoma kwakakwira kwakadhonza avhareji kumusoro.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaverenga median 250 seichireva kuti mhuri 5 dziri kurutivi rwakadzika dziri pa 250 kana pasi.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Unogona kunge wakashaya muganho wakaiswa nemedian ye 250 pahuwandu hwemhuri dzepamusoro. Kana mhuri 7 dziri pa 400 kana kupfuura, mari ye 5 yaizofanira kuva yei?
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Hauna kuverenga median. Funga kuti kukosha kwepakati kwaizova kwei kana mhuri 9 dziri pa 400 kana kupfuura.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Pakupedzisira, mari dzemwedzi dzemhuri 10 dzinoratidzwa kubva padiki (mu 만 원). 200, 200, 220, 240, 250, 250, 260, 280, 300, 1800.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Chiziviso chipi chakanakisa chekuzivisa mari yemhuri 'yakajairika' mumusha uyu?
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Mhuri 9 dziri pa 200 kusvika 300만 원 uye mhuri imwe iri pa 1,800만 원, zvinoita avhareji ive 400. Nekuparadzirwa kwakadai, unoda kupa median kana kuparadzirwa pamwe chete neavhareji kudzivisa kunzwisisa kwakaipa.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Nyora nemavara makuru pamusoro pechiziviso kuti, sezvo avhareji iri 400, vagari vazhinji vanowana anenge 400만 원 pamwedzi
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kutonga uku kwakaverenga avhareji se 'zvakajairika' chete. Ienzanise nemari chaiyo yemhuri.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Nyora kuti, sezvo avhareji iri 400, mari dzemhuri dzemusha uyu dzakaunganidzwa zvakaenzana
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakapedza kuti zvakaenzana kubva pachokwadi chokuti avhareji yakafanana. Tarisa musiyano pakati pekukosha kukuru nekwakasara.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Nyora kuti mhuri imwe yakakwira, iyo yakakwidza avhareji, uye vazhinji vari pa 200 kusvika 300만 원
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakatarisa avhareji nekuparadzirwa pamwe chete uye wakataura huwandu hwemari yemhuri dzakawanda.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s1.reflect: Nhamba imwe chete, avhareji ye 400, yakaverengwa zvakasiyana padanho rega rega. Tarisazve kuti wakashandura sei kutonga kwako kwapakutanga kana ruzivo rutsva rwauya, uye chii chaiva njodzi pachiziviso chakashandisa avhareji chete.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora patsva 'Avhareji yemari yemwedzi ndi 400만 원' yechiziviso kuti irege kukonzera kunzwisisa kwakaipa. Shandisa nhamba mbiri kana kupfuura.

x-m-el-cul-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isa chikonzero mumutsara mumwe zvakare, kuti vavakidzani vanoverenga chiziviso varege kunzwisisa zvisizvo.
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakashandisa here avhareji nemedian pamwe chete uye ukatsanangura chikonzero chemusiyano pakati pazvo (mhuri imwe yakakwira zvikuru)?
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Muverengi anogona kuziva here kuti 'mhuri yakajairika' inogona kuwana mari yakadini?
x-m-el-cul-05.s.s2.model.0: Avhareji ndi 400만 원, asi mhuri imwe inowana 1,800만 원, iyo yakakwidza avhareji, uye median ndi 250만 원, uye mhuri dzakawanda dzinowana 300만 원 kana pasi.
